scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n relay,dashboard -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/relay" "npm run dev -w apps/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/relay && npm run build -w apps/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/relay && npm run typecheck -w apps/dashboard
